newsitem.title: USA: US dealers take 5 cts protection corn, 5-15 soy.
newsitem.headline: US dealers take 5 cts protection corn, 5-15 soy.

text.p: U.S. Midwest cash grain dealers reported taking five cents per bushel protection on corn and five to 15 cents protection on soybeans Tuesday in response to higher-than-expected production estimates from U.S. Agriculture Department.
USDA estimated the soybean crop at 2.403 billion bushels. That figure came in above the trade consensus of 2.376 billion and was considered bearish for CBOT futures, cash sources said.
The government's corn crop estimate fo 9.265 billion bushels also surpassed the trade average 9.147 billion and was expected to pressure futures, traders said..
